page.overview:
Who is Rix?

Inspector Rix was a character in The Graben Gang.

Rix was appointed as security inspector to Depot 12 after the previous inspector had to spend three weeks in a tranquility pod. Upon his arrival, he informed Duv Dennick and Franklin Munt that he was there to conduct a thorough inspection of the security initiatives, which he found to be among the worst in the Imperial Basin. Duv stated that the Kirab were to blame for this, to which Rix replied that he would decide who would be blamed. Rix was bewildered when Frank activated Gary, his newly-constructed sentry automaton. However, Rix was killed when the machine mistook them for intruders and attacked.
